lines.ref:
What's not okay is
staying somewhere where
you're not valued, respected,
or appreciated.

shots.brief: sitting outdoors drinking water, medium shot (ref: Young man sitting on an outdoor park bench taking a drink from a water bottle.; tripod)
sitting in a car sipping a beverage (ref: Young man sitting inside a car sipping a cold iced drink through a cup.; selfie)
sitting at a table indoors looking contemplative (ref: Sitting at a table indoors with a gallon water bottle, cheeks puffed.; tripod)
walking outdoors or browsing plants/shops (ref: Walking outdoors past potted plant stands outside a storefront, turning head slightly.; filmed by friend)
crouching or relaxing on grass outdoors at golden hour (ref: Crouching on an open lawn at golden hour next to a water jug, looking off into the distance.; tripod)
running or walking away from the camera into golden light (ref: Jogging away down a paved road directly towards a low bright sun.; tripod)

audit.notes: Perfect format for any solo lifestyle b-roll library (walking through the city, sitting in coffee shops, subway rides, outdoor park clips, or running). Any 5-6 calm, reflective cuts can be used to deliver this list-style affirmation format.
audit.summary: A sequence of relaxed solo lifestyle clips paired with reassuring '...is okay' text statements, finishing on a message against staying where you are undervalued.
